# Data reading

```{r}
source("func/ord_class_index.R")
source("func/index.R")

library(ordinalForest)
library(pdfCluster)
library(psych)

dati <- read.csv("ESS7e02_3.csv")
```

# Missing values

```{r}
vars_7799 <- c("sclmeet", "inprdsc", "eduyrs", "hhmmb")
for (v in intersect(vars_7799, names(dati))) dati[[v]][dati[[v]] %in% c(77, 88, 99)] <- NA

vars_789 <- c("fltlnl", "sclact", "hincfel", "health")
for (v in intersect(vars_789, names(dati))) dati[[v]][dati[[v]] %in% c(7, 8, 9)] <- NA

if ("gndr" %in% names(dati)) dati$gndr[dati$gndr %in% 9] <- NA
if ("agea" %in% names(dati)) dati$agea[dati$agea %in% 999] <- NA
```

# Data preparation

```{r}
factor_vars <- c("gndr", "cntry")
factor_vars <- intersect(factor_vars, names(dati))
dati[factor_vars] <- lapply(dati[factor_vars], as.factor)

dati$y     <- factor(dati$fltlnl, ordered = TRUE)   # 4 classes, not merged
dati$group <- factor(dati$cntry)

xnam <- c("sclmeet", "inprdsc", "sclact", "agea", "gndr",
          "eduyrs", "hincfel", "hhmmb", "health")

vars_keep <- c("y", "group", xnam)
dati_sel  <- dati[, vars_keep]
n_before  <- nrow(dati_sel)
dati_model <- na.omit(dati_sel)
n_after   <- nrow(dati_model)
cat(sprintf("Listwise deletion: %d -> %d rows (%.1f%% dropped)\n",
            n_before, n_after, 100 * (n_before - n_after) / n_before))

# Randomly sample 500 per country (to reduce computation, independent of y)
set.seed(1999)
sub_n <- 500
dati_model <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(dati_model, dati_model$group), function(d) {
  d[sample.int(nrow(d), size = min(nrow(d), sub_n)), ]
}))
dati_model <- droplevels(dati_model)

cat(sprintf("Subsample: %d rows, %d countries\n",
            nrow(dati_model), length(levels(dati_model$group))))
table(dati_model$y)
```

# Support functions

```{r}
fit_with_warnings <- function(expr) {
  warns <- character(0)
  fit <- withCallingHandlers(
    tryCatch(expr, error = function(e) {
      structure(list(error = conditionMessage(e)), class = "fit_error")
    }),
    warning = function(w) {
      warns <<- c(warns, conditionMessage(w))
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    }
  )
  list(fit = fit, warnings = warns)
}

predict_of_unified <- function(model, newdata, xnam, lev) {
  nd <- newdata[, xnam, drop = FALSE]
  p  <- predict(model, newdata = nd)
  prob <- as.data.frame(p$classprobs)
  if (!all(as.character(lev) %in% names(prob))) {
    if (ncol(prob) == length(lev)) names(prob) <- as.character(lev)
  }
  prob <- prob[, as.character(lev), drop = FALSE]
  names(prob) <- lev
  resp <- factor(as.character(p$ypred), levels = lev, ordered = TRUE)
  list(mu = prob, response = resp)
}

confusion_full <- function(y_true, y_pred, lev) {
  tab <- table(factor(y_true, levels = lev, ordered = TRUE),
               factor(y_pred, levels = lev, ordered = TRUE))
  dimnames(tab) <- list(observed = lev, predicted = lev)
  tab
}

ordinal_index_safe <- function(cm) {
  if (!exists("OrdinalClassificationIndex")) return(NA_real_)
  tryCatch(OrdinalClassificationIndex(cm, nrow(cm)), error = function(e) NA_real_)
}

newindex_safe <- function(mu, y_num, K) {
  if (!exists("newindex")) return(NA_real_)
  if (is.null(mu)) return(NA_real_)
  tryCatch(newindex(mu, y_num, K)$norm.index, error = function(e) NA_real_)
}

weighted_kappa_safe <- function(y_true, y_pred, lev, weights = "quadratic") {
  y_true <- factor(y_true, levels = lev, ordered = TRUE)
  y_pred <- factor(y_pred, levels = lev, ordered = TRUE)
  tab <- table(y_true, y_pred)
  n <- sum(tab)
  K <- length(lev)
  if (n == 0 || K < 2) return(NA_real_)
  d <- abs(row(tab) - col(tab))
  if (weights == "linear") W <- d / (K - 1)
  else if (weights == "quadratic") W <- (d / (K - 1))^2
  else stop("weights must be 'linear' or 'quadratic'")
  O <- tab / n
  E <- outer(rowSums(tab), colSums(tab)) / n^2
  den <- sum(W * E)
  if (den == 0) return(NA_real_)
  1 - sum(W * O) / den
}

macro_precision <- function(y_true, y_pred, lev) {
  prec <- sapply(lev, function(c) {
    tp <- sum(y_true == c & y_pred == c)
    fp <- sum(y_true != c & y_pred == c)
    if ((tp + fp) == 0) NA else tp / (tp + fp)
  })
  mean(prec, na.rm = TRUE)
}

macro_recall <- function(y_true, y_pred, lev) {
  rec <- sapply(lev, function(c) {
    tp <- sum(y_true == c & y_pred == c)
    fn <- sum(y_true == c & y_pred != c)
    if ((tp + fn) == 0) NA else tp / (tp + fn)
  })
  mean(rec, na.rm = TRUE)
}

model_metrics <- function(name, pred, y_true, lev) {
  y_num <- as.numeric(y_true)
  pred_num <- as.numeric(pred$response)
  cm <- confusion_full(y_true, pred$response, lev)
  data.frame(
    model = name,
    accuracy = mean(y_num == pred_num),
    recall = macro_recall(y_num, pred_num, seq_along(lev)),
    precision = macro_precision(y_num, pred_num, seq_along(lev)),
    rmse = sqrt(mean((y_num - pred_num)^2)),
    mae = mean(abs(y_num - pred_num)),
    ordinal_classification_index = ordinal_index_safe(cm),
    adjusted_rand_index = adj.rand.index(y_num, pred_num),
    cohen_kappa = cohen.kappa(cbind(y_num, pred_num))$kappa,
    cohen_weighted_kappa = weighted_kappa_safe(y_true, y_pred = pred$response,
                                               lev = lev, weights = "quadratic"),
    new_index = newindex_safe(pred$mu, y_num, length(lev))
  )
}
```

# Incremental predictive value (5-fold CV)

```{r}
n_folds <- 5

# 4 nested models: base excludes inprdsc / sclact
base_vars <- setdiff(xnam, c("inprdsc", "sclact"))
model_specs <- list(
  base         = base_vars,
  base_inprdsc = c(base_vars, "inprdsc"),
  base_sclact  = c(base_vars, "sclact"),
  all          = xnam
)

# Fold assignment: within each country, stratify by y and split into 5 parts (consistent with the main analysis)
set.seed(1999)
fold_id <- integer(nrow(dati_model))
for (g in levels(dati_model$group)) {
  idx <- which(dati_model$group == g)
  yg  <- droplevels(dati_model$y[idx])
  fold_g <- integer(length(idx))
  for (cl in levels(yg)) {
    j <- which(yg == cl)
    fold_g[j] <- sample(rep(seq_len(n_folds), length.out = length(j)))
  }
  fold_id[idx] <- fold_g
}
cat("Sample size per fold:\n"); print(table(fold_id))

results_list <- vector("list", n_folds)

for (fold in seq_len(n_folds)) {
  cat("\n===== Fold", fold, "/", n_folds, "=====\n")

  test_idx  <- which(fold_id == fold)
  train_idx <- which(fold_id != fold)
  data_train <- droplevels(dati_model[train_idx, ])
  data_test  <- dati_model[test_idx, ]

  # Align factor levels (gndr)
  for (v in names(data_train)) {
    if (is.factor(data_train[[v]])) {
      data_test[[v]] <- factor(data_test[[v]], levels = levels(data_train[[v]]),
                               ordered = is.ordered(data_train[[v]]))
    }
  }
  data_test <- data_test[!is.na(data_test$y) & !is.na(data_test$gndr), ]

  y           <- data_train$y
  lev         <- levels(y)
  y_test_orig <- data_test$y

  rows_list <- list()
  for (nm in names(model_specs)) {
    xs <- model_specs[[nm]]
    of_res <- fit_with_warnings(
      ordfor(depvar = "y", perffunction = "probability",
             data = data_train[, c("y", xs)])
    )
    of_fit <- of_res$fit
    if (!inherits(of_fit, "fit_error")) {
      po_test <- tryCatch(predict_of_unified(of_fit, data_test, xs, lev),
                          error = function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(po_test)) {
        m <- model_metrics(nm, po_test, y_test_orig, lev)
        m$fold <- fold
        rows_list[[length(rows_list) + 1]] <- m
      }
    }
  }
  results_list[[fold]] <- do.call(rbind, rows_list)

  cat("  test acc:",
      paste(sprintf("%s=%.3f", results_list[[fold]]$model,
                    results_list[[fold]]$accuracy), collapse = " | "), "\n")
}
```

# IPV summary

```{r}
results_all <- do.call(rbind, results_list)

# 5-fold mean +/- SD per model (3 core metrics)
summ <- do.call(rbind, lapply(unique(results_all$model), function(md) {
  g <- results_all[results_all$model == md, ]
  data.frame(
    model    = md,
    acc_mean = mean(g$accuracy),  acc_sd  = sd(g$accuracy),
    kap_mean = mean(g$cohen_weighted_kappa), kap_sd = sd(g$cohen_weighted_kappa),
    mae_mean = mean(g$mae),        mae_sd  = sd(g$mae)
  )
}))
summ <- summ[match(c("base", "base_inprdsc", "base_sclact", "all"), summ$model), ]
print(summ, row.names = FALSE)

# Incremental predictive value (relative to base; higher accuracy/kappa is better, lower MAE is better -> take the "improvement" uniformly)
base <- summ[summ$model == "base", ]
ipv <- data.frame(
  added = c("inprdsc", "sclact", "inprdsc + sclact (all)"),
  delta_accuracy = c(
    summ$acc_mean[summ$model == "base_inprdsc"] - base$acc_mean,
    summ$acc_mean[summ$model == "base_sclact"]  - base$acc_mean,
    summ$acc_mean[summ$model == "all"]          - base$acc_mean
  ),
  delta_kappa = c(
    summ$kap_mean[summ$model == "base_inprdsc"] - base$kap_mean,
    summ$kap_mean[summ$model == "base_sclact"]  - base$kap_mean,
    summ$kap_mean[summ$model == "all"]          - base$kap_mean
  ),
  delta_mae = c(
    base$mae_mean - summ$mae_mean[summ$model == "base_inprdsc"],
    base$mae_mean - summ$mae_mean[summ$model == "base_sclact"],
    base$mae_mean - summ$mae_mean[summ$model == "all"]
  )
)
print(ipv, row.names = FALSE)

saveRDS(results_all, "ipv_results.rds")

```
